keywords: campus location;where is nemsu;where is the campus;nemsu location;where is tandag main campus
answer: NEMSU Tandag Main Campus is in Tandag City, Surigao del Sur, Philippines.
There are three main gates. The 1st Gate is near the CBM departments, the 2nd Gate is not far from the CBM area (the 1st Canteen is near it), and the 3rd Gate is near the ICT/CITE area.

The 2nd Gate is not far from the CBM area. The 1st Canteen is near this gate.
The 3rd Gate is near the ICT/CITE area.
The 1st Gate is near the CBM departments, and the 2nd Gate is not far from the CBM area.
The campus has two canteens. The 1st Canteen is near the 2nd Gate and the CBM area. The 2nd Canteen is near the Library and CAS.
The 1st Canteen is near the 2nd Gate and the CBM area.
The 2nd Canteen is near the Library and CAS.
The Library is near CAS and the 2nd Canteen.

CAS (College of Arts and Sciences) is near the Library and the 2nd Canteen. Programs include Political Science, Biology, Midwifery, BS Mathematics, Environmental Science, English Language and Filipino.

CBM (College of Business and Management) is near the 1st Gate and relatively near the 2nd Gate. Programs include Hospitality Management, Financial Management, Marketing Management and Public Administration.
